description: Ballarat Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. Traffic Counts from Ballarat. Attributes include the data collected, Road the count was collected on, Location of the collection counter, Direction of traffic, Days data collected, Midweek average daily traffic, weekend average daily traffic, 7 day average daily traffic, average traffic per hour, Lat, Long - EPSG 4326 Although all due care has been taken ... Coverage: City of Ballarat. The portal files it under the publisher City of Ballarat. Its tags are ballarat, traffic. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SHP, WFS. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
